grammar.head: Could you please…
grammar.sentence: Could you please cc my manager on all vendor emails?
grammar.sentenceZh: 能否請您在寄給供應商的所有郵件中副本給我的主管？

grammar.head: Would it be possible…
grammar.meaning: Would it be possible 句型
grammar.sentence: Would it be possible to reschedule our call to Thursday?
grammar.sentenceZh: 能否將我們的通話改到週四？

grammar.head: Casual vs polite
grammar.meaning: 普通 vs 禮貌對比
grammar.sentence: I need the report today. → I was wondering if I could receive the report today.
grammar.sentenceZh: 我今天需要報告。→ 不知是否能在今天收到報告？
grammar.speakText: I was wondering if I could receive the report today.

grammar.head: I would be grateful if…
grammar.meaning: I would be grateful if 句型
grammar.sentence: I would be grateful if you could approve the budget by noon.
grammar.sentenceZh: 若您能在中午前核准預算，我將不勝感激。

grammar.head: Direct ↔ polite request
grammar.meaning: 直接要求與禮貌請求對比
grammar.sentence: Send the file today. → Could you please send the file by the end of the day?
grammar.sentenceZh: 今天寄檔案。→ 能否請您今天下班前寄出檔案？
grammar.speakText: Could you please send the file by the end of the day?

grammar.head: Direct ↔ diplomatic disagreement
grammar.meaning: 直接反對與外交式不同意
grammar.sentence: That is wrong. → I see your point, though I interpret the data differently.
grammar.sentenceZh: 那是錯的。→ 我理解您的觀點，但我對數據的解讀不同。
grammar.speakText: I see your point, though I interpret the data differently.

grammar.head: Need ↔ would appreciate
grammar.sentence: I need your approval. → I would appreciate your approval when convenient.
grammar.sentenceZh: 我需要你核准。→ 方便時若能核准，我將不勝感激。
grammar.speakText: I would appreciate your approval when convenient.

grammar.head: No ↔ may not be able to
grammar.sentence: We cannot accept the price. → We may not be able to accept the current price.
grammar.sentenceZh: 我們不能接受價格。→ 目前價格我們恐怕難以接受。
grammar.speakText: We may not be able to accept the current price.

grammar.head: You must ↔ it would be helpful if
grammar.sentence: You must revise the report. → It would be helpful if the report could be revised.
grammar.sentenceZh: 你必須修改報告。→ 若能修改報告，會很有幫助。
grammar.speakText: It would be helpful if the report could be revised.

grammar.head: Problem ↔ concern
grammar.sentence: There is a problem with the plan. → I have a concern about the current plan.
grammar.sentenceZh: 這個計畫有問題。→ 我對目前計畫有一點疑慮。
grammar.speakText: I have a concern about the current plan.
